"“This is an excellent book… When you start reading, be sure you don’t have to wake up early!”
—Reader review for The Killing Game

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Former gambler-turned-FBI Agent Parker Hand has learned to master high pressure and high stakes—but when a cunning killer targets elite poker players, Parker realizes all is not what it seems—and that she just may be in the race of her life to outwit a killer before he comes for her next…

AGAINST THE DARK is the first book in a new series by #1 bestselling mystery and suspense author Kate Bold, whose bestseller NOT ME (a free download) has received over 3,000 five star ratings and reviews.

In the high-stakes world of Parker Hand, mystery, thriller and suspense collide, delivering page turning action and twists until the last page. Fans of Melinda Leigh, Kendra Elliot, and Teresa Driscoll are sure to fall in love.

Future books in the series are also available!
